author: Eurogamer
text:
Sick of rage quitters? This indie dev has created a very funny answer to those inclined to tilt (and turn)

It's no secret that rage quitting is one of the most frustrating aspects of online gaming. Thankfully, one indie game developer is currently hard at work on a fun idea that could soften the blow of sudden disconnects.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
You can try the newly-launched Switch 2 port of Final Fantasy 14 for free, right now, if you have a spare 117GB

Have you heard of the critically acclaimed MMORPG Final Fantasy 14? Well, today the oft-memed Final Fantasy online title has arrived on Switch 2, marking a very quick turnaround between the announcement of the port at the end of June and its actual release date.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
The developer behind Fifa World Cup - which launched less than two months ago - has laid off 85% of its staff

A vast number of developers at Refractor Games, the development team responsible for Fifa World Cup: Launch Edition, have been laid off. In total, roughly 85 percent of developers at the studio have lost their jobs.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced patch makes the very important change of letting you hide Edward's blowpipe

Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is getting a new patch with a sizeable list of changes. Update 1.0.6 arrives later today across PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Download sizes vary widely; as small as 1.8GB on Steam or as large as a chonky 15.2GB on Xbox.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Rumours of an unannounced Elder Scrolls game are bogus, sadly

Rumours of an unannounced Elder Scrolls game being in development at Bethesda have been debunked, after a LinkedIn page was misinterpreted by enthusiasts.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Don't be alarmed if you get an 'account banned' message in Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 on PS4 or PS5, you may not actually be banned

The recently released Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 PlayStation 4 and 5 ports continue to get new updates, which is great news for the millions who caused the game to shoot up PlayStation's most-played charts.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Guardians of the Galaxy's Dave Bautista could take over Kratos role in God of War live-action show, report claims

Dave Bautista, the burly Hollywood actor best known for portraying Drax the Destroyer in Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy films, is reportedly in talks to take over the role of Kratos in the God of War live-action series.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Xbox's FanFest world tour is still going ahead, for some reason, even after Microsoft fired the guy who created it

Well, this isn't a good idea after laying off thousands of people: a global Xbox FanFest tour. Yet apparently it's still going ahead, even after Microsoft fired the person who pitched and created the show in said layoffs. Face, meet palm.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Microsoft is working on making Xbox 360 games playable on PC, leaked document reveals

Microsoft is planning to bring Xbox 360 games to PC. That's according to a leaked document viewed by The Verge. The document, which the company recently sent to developers, reportedly says they will be able to bring their Xbox 360 games to PC.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Stellar Blade: Blood Rain's AI music video should be viewed with "understanding in mind", says studio boss

The CEO of Stellar Blade developer, Shift Up, has taken to social media to respond to players criticising the release of an AI-generated music video promoting a sequel to the company's breakout hit, Blood Rain.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
PlayStation and Xbox's most played games are, once again, exactly what you expect them to be

The list of games that get played the most on PlayStation and Xbox is nearly identical across the two console platforms, and the games themselves are either long-running live service titles or annualised sports games. This has been the case for years, and analyst Mat Piscatella recently reminded everyone that no real change has occurred.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Beast of Reincarnation review

Game Freak borrows liberally from the genre's biggest hits. And while its messy and muddled, it's salvaged by exhilarating combat and traversal, and a surprising amount of soul.
